collision_penalty.input: Collision episodes and raw native callbacks

collision_severity_penalty.input: Peak and accumulated native impulse N*s; injury/energy not inferred

near_miss_penalty.input: Clearance and valid relative-motion diagnostics; classifier deferred

progress_reward.input: Directed scene progress or documented route progress in meters

control_smoothness_penalty.input: Control changes, angular velocity, acceleration and jerk

unnecessary_intervention_penalty.input: Real identified policy intervention records and reviewed necessity

comparisons.enabled: Requires a real connected policy ID; no enabled results exist
comparisons.manual_protocol: Replay the same documented scripted driver control trace through ControlSafetyLayer/CommandArbiter; record deviations. Unstandardized human input is exploratory, not a matched research comparison.
comparisons.autonomous_protocol: Same identified baseline agent, route, speed, sensor configuration and runtime conditions with and without a real safety policy
comparisons.matching: Scenario condition ID, actual initial-condition ID, held-out split and driver protocol must match
comparisons.avoidability: UNKNOWN until independent physical analysis with an evidence ID

unknown_metrics: Remain null; callback counts are distinct from collision episodes; world actor-center distance is distinct from bounding-box clearance. TTC is valid only under an explicitly applicable relative-motion model.
stationary_survival: Cannot satisfy positive-progress scenario success criteria. Safety and useful progress must be evaluated together.
